Kit summary

Ninjutsu · ChidoriBasic
Deals 2 stages of 200% ATK [Bleed] DMG each to a single enemy. Each stage has a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] on the target for 2 turns.
Ninjutsu · AmaterasuActiveExclusive Lv.1
Attacks a single enemy, dealing 800% ATK [Bleed] DMG and stealing 30% Mastery from the target for 2 turns. Afterward, triggers the target's [Bleed] effect 2 times and each trigger will reduce the remaining duration of all [Bleed] effects by 1 turn.
Ninjato · Tsukuyomi Lv.1Ninjutsu · Amaterasu additionally steals 20% DMG RES from the target. Before the end of self turns, Mutsuki additionally casts Ninjutsu · Amaterasu once to the enemy with the highest ATK.
Hijutsu · Phantom VeilPassive
Converts 80% of initial Effect Hit into Mastery, up to 140% Mastery can be gained through this effect. At the beginning of each turn, gains [Stealth] for 1 turn. When dealing Basic Attack DMG or Skill DMG while under [Stealth] status, gains 1 layer of [Ninpo · Moonless] (each layer increases ATK by 10% and [Bleed] DMG by 10%, up to 10 layers). If more than 3 allies are under [Stealth] status, Mutsuki immediately removes [Stealth] from herself and loses all layers of [Ninpo · Moonless].
Ougi · Hundred BlossomsActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Removes all removable [Shield] from all enemies. Afterward, deals 3 stages of 170% ATK [Bleed] DMG each to all enemies and each stage has a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] on the targets for 2 turns. If a target has an irremovable [Shield] before DMG is dealt, this DMG ignores [Shield], and additionally deals 50% [Bleed] DMG to the target. Steals 50% Effect Hit from all enemies (caps at 80% of self initial Effect Hit); the stolen Effect Hit is converted into Mastery at a 50% ratio for 2 turns.
Ninjato · Tsukuyomi Lv.2Ougi · Hundred Blossoms additionally steals 10% Turn Meter from all enemies and increases all enemies' skill CD by 1 turn. Afterward, grants all allies [Resolute II] for 2 turns.
Ninjato · Tsukuyomi Lv.3For every 1 ally with the [Bleed] tag deployed, each layer of [Ninpo · Moonless] additionally increases ATK by 1% and [Bleed] DMG by 1%. When 5 allies with the [Bleed] tag are deployed, each layer of [Ninpo · Moonless] increases DMG dealt by Mutsuki to Boss by 25%. When 5 allies with the [Attribute Steal] tag are deployed, for every 10 [Shield] gained by enemies, Mutsuki immediately casts Ougi · Hundred Blossoms once.
Source: game files.

Traveler’s Diary
The Traveler's Diary
Main statATK Rate

At the beginning of the owner's turn, grants one of the Travelogue Pages randomly to all allies:

1. Increases all allies' ATK by 9% of the owner's initial ATK.

2. Increases all allies' Crit DMG by 27%.

3. Increases all allies' Skill DMG by 9%.

Only 1 layer of Travelogue Page can be owned at the same time and all allies share the same effect. The effects mentioned above will be removed once the owner dies.

Uplifting Drums
Uplifting Drums
Main statEffect Hit

Increases all allies' ATK by 7% when a battle starts.

If an ally is inflicted with Block Removal, the ally will gain 1 layer of Energizing Notes at the end of the following 3 turns, up to 1 layer can be gained at the end of each turn. Each layer of Energizing Notes increases ATK by 1.4%, up to 40 layers. This effect will not be removed when the owner dies or at the wave transition.

Additionally, when an ally is inflicted with Block Removal in their first 3 turns each wave, there is a 100% chance to gain 1 extra layer. This chance is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES.

If the same Echo is equipped by multiple allies at the same time in a battle, only one of them will take effect.

Moongazing Phantom
Moongazing Phantom
Main statATK Rate

Increases the owner's Poison DMG dealt by 21%.

If the owner is from Sword Harbor Guards:

1. When dealing Poison DMG, increases the target's DoT taken by 30%, up to 5 layers, lasting for 2 turns.
